Method of Attack: Encrypts files on network drives, network shares, USB drives, external disks, internal disks, and cloud storage apps using AES-256 encryption; deletes shadow volume copies and overwrites RecycleBin content multiple times; ransom note ransom demand multiplied by 10 if infected target is part of a domain
Impacted Systems: Cloud storage apps (Onedrive, Dropbox, Google Drive, Steam)
